mixRecommendation.normalization: Use a constant source gain as a starting comparison; do not normalize every tiny cut independently or increase low ambience merely to reach a number. Full selected bus and final narration masking require review.
mixRecommendation.duckTarget: Game source bus only. Never duck the narration because game sound starts.
mixRecommendation.synchronization: Cut source audio at the same native in/out as selected gameplay, preserving source timing. No looped game ambience or made-up replacement effects.
mixRecommendation.combinedSourceMusic: Retain game music embedded with effects in the six retained sources; do not remove it merely because added BGM has a different contract. If added approved BGM competes, reduce the added BGM first (existing initial extra-3dB guidance).
mixRecommendation.worldException: Only currently selected World Maker range groups are muted. No verified voice-free subrange or isolated music/effects stem was established, so do not claim a clean instrumental restoration.
mixRecommendation.sum: amix normalize=0; avoid duplicate video-player audio plus mixed master.
mixRecommendation.finalEncode: 48kHzstereoAAC192kbps, measured final true peak at or below-1.5dBTP.
mixRecommendation.finalReview: Inspect speech masking, source cuts and level continuity on the actual final mix. These samples do not approve the final mix or human full listening.
